resources.string: A native preview for temporary local notes and delegated SMS composition. RCS, MMS, and encrypted DATA are not integrated yet.
SMS · delegated to device messaging app
This does not send or store a message in GoreeCloud. Review and tap Send in your chosen messaging app. The other app chooses whether it uses SMS, MMS or another service.
No compatible messaging app is installed.
Enter a valid phone number (3–15 digits).
Your existing messaging app will open with a draft. Nothing was sent.
Save notes on this screen without sending anything. Notes stay in memory and disappear when the app restarts, closes, or rotates. Not encrypted or backed up.
This immediately discards every saved local note on this screen. It cannot be undone.
No SMS permissions · No message interception · No silent fallback · No tracking
